definition: Alexei "Lex" Fridman (born 15 August 1983) is an American computer scientist and podcaster.
details: Interviews with leading AI figures. Since 2018, he has hosted the Lex Fridman Podcast, where he interviews notable figures from various fields such as science, technology, sports, the arts, and politics. Fridman rose to prominence in 2019 after Elon Musk praised a study Fridman authored at MIT, which concluded that drivers remained focused while using Tesla's semi-autonomous driving system.

explainer.lead: Lex Fridman is an American scientist and podcast host (born 1983). His work spans computer vision and artificial intelligence.
explainer.knownFor: Notable works include Lex Fridman Podcast.

timeline.what: He then went on to obtain B.S. and M.S. degrees in computer science at Drexel University in 2010, and completed his Ph.D. in electrical and computer engineering at Drexel in 2014.
That year Fridman transitioned to an unpaid role at MIT AgeLab, and since 2022 has worked as a research scientist at the MIT Laboratory for Information and Decision Systems (LIDS).
As of February 2024, Fridman lives in Texas and is employed at MIT.
